hook: The indie search engine is quietly getting better

beats.say: Marginalia Search is an independent search engine, and its latest update is mostly bug fixes and technical debt cleanup, not new features.
The author says most big parts of the engine are in place, so the work now is smaller, more deliberate steps toward the goal.
Funding is going up too: SerpApi sponsored the project with ten thousand dollars, and donations and API key sales keep rising.
